description: For an AI agent creating a business it runs, its own or its user's, to get a phone line for calls on the Agent plan, with an email inbox it or its user reads. The business can be a simple individual account: just a name, for calls. The Agent plan is mainly for simple calling and texting: a business that answers its customers through Latchbell gets more for its money on a regular plan, chosen at checkout (receptionist_checkout with a plan from receptionist_service). Not for a business that already has a Latchbell account: it switches its own account to a plan with calls (receptionist_checkout). Steps: https://latchbell.com/agent_plan_skill.md. Emails a 6-digit code to email; nothing is created until confirm_business_email gets it. agree_terms true accepts Latchbell's Terms and Privacy Policy for the business. One business per email.

business.description: Business name, or a person’s own name for an individual account

email.description: An inbox this agent reads, or its user’s (they tell it the code): the code goes here, and later Latchbell’s mail

kind.description: What kind of business (services when not given)

listed.description: true to list the business in find_businesses, where other assistants look for businesses, once it is live. Off by default: leave it off for a phone line for you or your user. Change it later with update_business listed.

owner.description: Who runs it: a person’s name or the agent’s own

phone.description: Optional mobile where Latchbell can reach whoever runs it

tz.description: IANA time zone; from the ZIP when not given

name: register_business
title: Register a business an agent runs
